findings.location: Remember, it is …the fearful, and unbelieving … [who] shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone… –Revelation 21:8.
findings.source_quote: “…the fearful, and unbelieving … [who] shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone… –Revelation 21:8.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English theological term 'unbelieving' as a standard Hindi equivalent that preserves the doctrinal sense (अविश्वासी). Replace 'अस्वस्थदिल' with 'अविश्वासी'. Keep the rest of the verse translation intact. Example fix (within the existing HTML and tags): …भयभीत और अविश्वासी … [जिनका भाग वह झील है जो आग और सल्फर से जलती है] — प्रकाशितवाक्य 21:8।
findings.translation_quote: “…भयभीत और अस्वस्थदिल … [जिनका भाग वह झील है जो आग और सल्फर से जलती है] — प्रकाशितवाक्य 21:8।”

findings.location: The story paragraph referencing 1 Corinthians 14 and being 'edified'
findings.source_quote: “All that he heard was what 1 Corinthians chapter 14 refers to as tongues (languages) and since he didn’t understand the language and since there was no interpretation given, he was not able to be edified.”
findings.suggested_fix: The English 'edified' (theological term meaning 'built up' or 'benefited spiritually') should be rendered by a clearer Hindi theological equivalent. Replace 'वह निर्मित नहीं हो सका' with 'वह लाभ नहीं उठा सका' or 'वह आध्यात्मिक रूप से निर्मित/उन्नत नहीं हो सका'. Example: 'वह उस भाषा को न समझने तथा कोई व्याख्या न होने के कारण आध्यात्मिक रूप से पोषित/उन्नत नहीं हो सका।' Preserve HTML tags and surrounding sentence structure.
findings.translation_quote: “जो कुछ वह सुनता था वह 1 कुरिन्थियों अध्याय 14 में वर्णित भाषाएँ थीं और चूँकि वह उस भाषा को नहीं समझता था और न ही कोई व्याख्या दी जाती थी, वह निर्मित नहीं हो सका।”
